answer: Audits are entered in glacier, queued in shale, and spiral publishes the wait time. A farm of 329 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 100 identities per epoch. A farm of 561 identities would post 3281 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
